# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

**Prerequisite:** `map` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

Run `firecrawl map --help` for the full option list (sitemap handling, subdomains, etc.).

**Done when:** the URL list is saved under `.firecrawl/` and you have selected the URLs to scrape or crawl next.

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)
- [firecrawl-build-search](https://github.com/firecrawl/skills/tree/main/skills/build/firecrawl-build-search) — building URL discovery into an app instead of running it here

The built-in middleware section at https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin has 26 pages. I got the page list from the docs sidebar. I wrote the one-line descriptions from what I know of Hono, and I didn't open each page to check them.

| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| [basic-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/basic-auth) | Adds HTTP Basic authentication, checking a username and password against the `Authorization` header. |
| [bearer-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/bearer-auth) | Checks the bearer token in the `Authorization` header and rejects requests without a valid one. |
| [body-limit](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/body-limit) | Rejects requests whose body is larger than a size you set. |
| [cache](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cache) | Caches responses using the Web Cache API (Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and similar runtimes). |
| [combine](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/combine) | Merges several middleware into one, using `some`, `every`, or `except` logic. |
| [compress](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/compress) | Compresses response bodies with gzip or deflate, depending on what the client accepts. |
| [context-storage](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/context-storage) | Stores the Hono `Context` in `AsyncLocalStorage`, so you can read it from anywhere in the request. |
| [cors](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cors) | Sets Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers and handles preflight requests. |
| [csrf](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/csrf) | Guards against CSRF attacks by checking the `Origin` header (and optionally `Sec-Fetch-Site`) on form-style requests. |
| [etag](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/etag) | Adds ETag headers to responses and returns 304 when the content hasn't changed. |
| [ip-restriction](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/ip-restriction) | Allows or blocks requests by client IP address or CIDR range. |
| [jsx-renderer](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jsx-renderer) | Lets you set a layout component that wraps JSX responses sent with `c.render()`. |
| [jwk](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwk) | Verifies JWTs using a JSON Web Key set, either given directly or fetched from a remote URI. |
| [jwt](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwt) | Verifies JSON Web Tokens with a secret or key to authenticate requests. |
| [logger](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/logger) | Logs each request's method, path, status, and elapsed time. |
| [language](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/language) | Detects the user's language from the query string, cookie, or `Accept-Language` header. |
| [method-not-allowed](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-not-allowed) | Returns 405 Method Not Allowed when a route exists but not for the requested method. |
| [method-override](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-override) | Lets a POST request act as another HTTP method, using a form field, header, or query value. |
| [mount](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/mount) | Mounts an app built on another framework or a plain fetch handler under a path prefix. |
| [pretty-json](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/pretty-json) | Pretty-prints JSON responses when the request has `?pretty`. |
| [request-id](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/request-id) | Gives each request a unique ID, available in the context and the `X-Request-Id` response header. |
| [secure-headers](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/secure-headers) | Sets security headers such as CSP, HSTS, `X-Frame-Options`, and `X-Content-Type-Options`. |
| [timeout](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timeout) | Aborts a request that takes longer than a set time and returns a timeout error. |
| [timing](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timing) | Adds `Server-Timing` headers so you can see backend timings in browser dev tools. |
| [trailing-slash](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/trailing-slash) | Redirects URLs to add or remove the trailing slash, so each URL has one canonical form. |

Hono also lists [Third-party Middleware](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/third-party) as a sibling section. It isn't part of the built-in set.
